- v7.4.0  Aug 3  — gpt-5.5 model + tool metadata fields; HTTP mTLS transport examples.

## THE STANDING RULE — cross-provider routing is now in the LIBRARIES, not just the CLIs
Both official SDKs (Python v3.2.0, Node v7.5.0) can target the Bedrock Runtime endpoint, where
`/anthropic` serves the Anthropic Messages API and `/openai/v1` serves the OpenAI shapes. Anthropic's
Compliance API explicitly does NOT capture sessions routed via Bedrock / Google Cloud / Foundry.
=> Per-vendor telemetry CANNOT establish coverage. Only the cloud account's own logging can.
   Select parsers by ROUTE PATH, not hostname. See amazon-bedrock_changelog.txt.

## status.openai.com — three RESOLVED incidents in window, below the bar
Aug 21 unexpected logouts for ChatGPT web users (Login component). Aug 20 elevated Codex API
authentication errors. Aug 20 elevated errors for Thinking mode (Image Generation, ChatGPT Work,
Conversations). Availability, not additions.

## HELD ITEM — EIGHTH consecutive scan
`gpt-realtime-2.1` / `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` still absent from every OpenAI surface, including both
SDK release streams. Open since ~2026-07-06.

## CORRECTION OF RECORD (see agent-plugins_spec.txt)
"Codex Agent Plugins" reported 2026-08-07 as an OpenAI capability is in fact OpenAI's implementation
of **Agent Plugins 1.0.0**, an open vendor-neutral standard (TSC: AWS, Cursor, Microsoft, OpenAI,
Vercel) also implemented by Cursor, GitHub Copilot, VS Code and Kiro. Model it once, cross-vendor.

## Doc pages named in changelogs that DO NOT EXIST (confirmed 2026-08-21)
learn.chatgpt.com/docs/gitlab, /docs/codex/gitlab, /docs/plugins/apple-messages — all 404.
OpenAI ships changelog entries ahead of their doc pages. Cite /docs/cloud for the GitLab beta.
